items.source: URI pattern for the matching handler if available, falling back to REDIRECTION for 3xx responses, NOT_FOUND for 404 responses, root for requests with no path info, and UNKNOWN for all other requests.
items.translation: 匹配处理程序的 URI 模式（如果可用），否则对于 3xx 响应回退到`REDIRECTION`，对于 404 响应回退到`NOT_FOUND`，对于没有路径信息的请求回退到`root`，对于所有其他请求回退到`UNKNOWN`。

items.source: HTTP response raw status code, or "UNKNOWN" if no response was created.
items.translation: HTTP 响应原始状态码，或者如果没有创建响应则为 `"UNKNOWN"`。

items.source:
Name of the exception thrown during the exchange, or
"none" if no exception was thrown.
items.translation: 交换期间抛出的异常名称，或者如果没有抛出异常则为 "none"。

items.source:
Name of the HTTP request method or "none" if the
request was not received properly.
items.translation: HTTP 请求方法的名称，或者如果请求未正确接收则为“none”。

items.source: Outcome of the HTTP server exchange.
items.translation: HTTP 服务器交换的结果。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
